content:
V low | center message bubble | the customer's message text is clipped to a single truncated line ("Hi Kim — … can you open th") inside a bubble that has room for more
V med | chat detail panel | raw debug strings leak into the UI: "customer 7 not in the mirror yet", "no agent is assigned — sending accepts this chat automatically", "the message id is generated here — a retry can never double-send"
L low | chat detail panel | the "Conversation" card is a narrow half-width floating box while all other content spans full panel width
H low | chat detail panel | message bubble is empty-looking: only clipped text and a timestamp compete with the "KO" avatar in equal visual weight
S low | chat detail panel | "End chat" button is flush-left against panel padding with no consistent left alignment anchor relative to the "Conversation" card above it
C high | bottom third of screen | large unmanaged dead zone below the "2 chats in the local mirror" footer occupies roughly 40% of the window with no content or structure
C low | chat detail panel | huge horizontal dead space to the right of the "Conversation" card and message area with no content balancing it
L med | chat detail panel | the clipped message bubble partially overlaps/collides with the section card that starts immediately below it, leaving only a sliver of gap

TOTAL 8
